sloka: एवं सञ्चिन्त्य विप्रेन्दो जगाम लघुविक्रमः ।आख्यातुं तद्यथावृत्तं यमस्य सदनं प्रति ।। ७.२१.१ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ sañcintya viprendo jagāma laghuvikramaḥ ।ākhyātuṁ tadyathāvṛttaṁ yamasya sadanaṁ prati ।। 7.21.1 ॥

translations.english: Having thus pondered, Narada, moving swiftly, went towards Yama's abode to narrate the events as they had transpired.
